summary: Microsoft Flight Simulator entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Microsoft Flight Simulator
entries.definitive_edition: Microsoft Flight Simulator 2020 40th Anniversary Edition on PC, with exact build/add-on/server state documented

emulation.notes: Use native PC build with documented peripherals and online-data settings.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current PC build with calibrated controls, online world data, and documented add-ons

primary.version: Microsoft Flight Simulator 40th Anniversary Edition / current 2020 build
primary.why: The 2020 Microsoft Flight Simulator entry is a living simulator platform with streamed scenery, marketplace content, avionics/sim updates, and peripheral state. The PC 40th Anniversary Edition route is the best capture and hardware route for this specific 2020 entry, while Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 is a separate successor.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current PC build of Microsoft Flight Simulator 2020. Record edition, sim update/build, install source, online/offline data settings, marketplace ownership, world updates, aircraft, airport/scenery add-ons, graphics/VR settings, controls, navdata, weather/time, route, and server state.

secondary.what_to_play: Use if documenting console performance or Xbox ecosystem ownership.
secondary.why: PC is the best capture/peripheral route.

secondary.exclusive_content: Separate successor with career/mission systems and later platform support
secondary.what_to_play: Track as a separate entry, not as a replacement for the 2020 entry.
secondary.why: 2020 continues to be supported after the 2024 launch.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not fold Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 into this entry; it is a separate successor.

entries.title: Microsoft Flight Simulator X
entries.definitive_edition: FSX: Steam Edition with addon/Acceleration state documented

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: FSX: Steam Edition or boxed FSX with exact addon/control setup documented

primary.version: Microsoft Flight Simulator X: Steam Edition with Acceleration/Deluxe content state documented
primary.why: FSX: Steam Edition is the practical current route because Dovetail re-released FSX for modern Windows and Steam multiplayer after GameSpy shutdown. The original boxed Deluxe/Acceleration route remains important for addon compatibility and historical comparison.
primary.how_to_play: Use FSX: Steam Edition unless a legacy addon requires boxed FSX. Record edition, service pack/Acceleration state, aircraft, scenery/addons, controls/yoke/pedals, realism settings, flight plan, weather, multiplayer/network state, and sim rate.

secondary.what_to_play: Use when required by older addons.
secondary.why: Steam Edition is the current route but not identical for every addon.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record edition and addon stack; do not merge with Microsoft Flight Simulator (2020/2024).
